name: Cooku with Comali
overview: Cooku with Comali, also known by the acronym CWC, is an Indian Tamil-language comedy-based cooking competition show aired on Star Vijay and streams on Disney+ Hotstar where the contestants are paired each week with comedians (comalis) who are amateur cooks. The first season premiered on 16 November 2019 and ended on 23 February 2020. The second season was premiered on 14 November 2020 and ended on 14 April 2021. The third season was premiered on 22 January 2022 and ended on 24 July 2022. The contestants along with their comalis are challenged every week and judged by Chef Damu and Chef Venkatesh Bhat.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Cooku with Comali (season 1) is the first season of the Tamil reality cooking TV show Cooku with Comali, that was aired first on 16 November 2020. This season was hosted by Rakshan and Aranthangi Nisha.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Cooku with Comali (season 2) is the second season of the Tamil reality cooking TV show Cooku with Comali, that was aired first on 14 November 2020. This season was hosted by Rakshan.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: Cooku with Comali (Season 3) is the third season of the Tamil reality cooking TV show Cooku with Comali, that was launched on 22 January 2022. This season is hosted by Rakshan, and judged by Chef Damodharan and Chef Venkatesh Bhat.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: Cooku with Comali (Season 4) is the fourth season of the Tamil reality cooking TV show Cooku with Comali, which will launch on 28th January 2023 on Star Vijay. Over four years, Cooku with Comali has rolled out three seasons and Rakshan has officially been appointed as the host for the fourth time. Chef Damodharan and Chef Venkatesh Bhat as the Judges.

seasons.name: Season 5
seasons.overview: Cooku with Comali (Season 5) is the fifth season of the Tamil reality cooking tv show.

seasons.name: Season 6
seasons.overview: When cooking chaos meets comic charm! Comalis pair up with stars for a rib-tickling contest, judged by chefs Damu, Koushik Shankar and Madhampatty Rangaraj.

seasons.name: Double Trouble
seasons.overview: Double trouble, endless laughter! Comalis pair up with your favourite celebrity couples for a hilarious culinary showdown.
